first_artifact: A real Performance Tests topology artifact containing raw retained samples, q25/q50/q75/cnt, first-key distributions, failures, resources, runner/browser/wp-env metadata, and per-run order.
acceptance_gate: Local row ordering is preserved, retained counts/failures do not regress, and candidate wait changes do not move resources or first-key tails into the measured interval.
stop_or_expand_rule: If ordering, variance, failures, or resource movement changes, expand the manifest before changing waits or thresholds.
premature_work_to_avoid: Changing waits or thresholds from local p50.

first_artifact: Focused behavior fixtures plus a source-span microscope for the next hot owner.
acceptance_gate: Behavior passes first, then source-span fanout collapses for the targeted owner.
stop_or_expand_rule: If behavior or source spans fail, do not run or cite aggregate p50; narrow the guard or move to another owner.
premature_work_to_avoid: Citing aggregate p50 before behavior and source-span evidence pass.

first_artifact: Unprivileged key-window/helper/renderer/collector/command schema with clock sync and no root collectors.
acceptance_gate: Every retained q50-contributing key joins to the expected helper, renderer, command, and collector placeholder rows without changing class ordering.
stop_or_expand_rule: If join coverage or class ordering fails, do not run root counters or browser trace categories.
premature_work_to_avoid: Running root counters or browser trace before join coverage and observer overhead are accepted.

first_artifact: Compact manifest under root powermetrics after sidecar acceptance.
acceptance_gate: Frequency/residency/QoS/power state separates ordinary/utility fast rows from no-CPU and background/maintenance rows.
stop_or_expand_rule: If powermetrics cannot separate rows, escalate to root trace; if trace also fails, keep only empirical CPU-state sensitivity.
premature_work_to_avoid: Naming hardware or scheduler causes from aggregate latency rows.

first_artifact: Runtime command sidecar joined to retained key gaps and runtime-repeat controls.
acceptance_gate: Repeated runtime checkpoints reproduce the dose response without observer perturbation and expose joinable runtime/scheduler fields.
stop_or_expand_rule: If the sidecar perturbs ordering or fields do not separate rows, stop naming Chromium internals.
premature_work_to_avoid: Adding more delay rows or trace-on-only explanations before trace-off joins exist.
